what: a flask of dragon's blood: a glass flask shaped like a fat heart with its point at the bottom, held in a cage of four thick black iron bands that meet in an iron knob under the point. what: a bottle of clear sparkling liquid: a flat glass bottle whose outline is a diamond, a square stood on one corner: a point at the bottom set in a small round silver foot, the widest corners at the left and right, and the top corner drawn out into a short neck. The glass and the liquid in it are very pale, silvery white with a faint cool grey shading toward the right, solid and bright, and across it lie four bold white sparkles, each a four-pointed star as big as the neck is wide, with dark grey edges. It is stopped with a faceted knob of clear cut glass. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Very pale silvery white with cool light-grey shading, four bold white four-pointed sparkles, a small silver foot, a clear cut-glass knob.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: diamond-outline bottle standing on a point

what: a plain flask of still water from the ancient world: a tall, simple bottle of thick, uneven, hand-blown glass, a cylinder three times as tall as it is wide with a gently rounded shoulder, a short neck and a thick rolled lip, a little lopsided, the glass wavy and old. It holds perfectly still, colourless water, shown as pale silver-grey: lightest grey-white on the left, a soft mid-grey down the right side, with a dead flat, level waterline drawn as one straight dark line across the bottle just below the shoulder, and plain pale empty glass above it. No bubbles, nothing in it. A strip of dark grey linen is tied round the neck in one knot with two short hanging ends, and the mouth is stopped with a plain dark cork.
colours: Pale silver-grey and grey-white, soft mid-grey shading on the right, one straight dark waterline, a dark charcoal-grey linen tie, a dark brown cork.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: tall plain hand-blown bottle with a rolled lip
colourless grey-white water with a level waterline
dark linen strip tied round the neck

what: a grey ashen draught: a small squat bottle shaped like a cube, as wide as it is tall, with four flat sides, sharp corners and flat square shoulders, and a short narrow neck in the middle of the top, like an old ink bottle. It is filled right up to its shoulders with flat, chalky, opaque pale grey liquid, the grey of cold wood ash, the same solid grey from the bottom all the way up to the shoulders with no empty space above it, and a darker charcoal-grey sediment settled in a thick layer at the bottom. Round the neck is a thick collar of dull dark grey lead, and it is stopped with a round ball of dark grey stone as wide as the collar. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Flat chalky pale ash grey with no colour in it, a charcoal-grey layer at the bottom, a dull white glint on one corner, a dark grey lead collar and a dark grey stone ball stopper.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: squat cube-shaped bottle with a short neck
solid pale ash-grey contents up to the shoulders
dark sediment layer at the bottom
dark lead collar and stone ball stopper

what: a stormy grey vial: a glass vial shaped like a tall narrow pyramid with four flat sides: a square flat base and straight sides leaning in to a small neck at the top, three times as tall as its base is wide. Inside it churn dark storm clouds: dark slate-grey and charcoal billows, heavy and rolling, with paler grey edges on each cloud, filling it from bottom to top. It is closed with a dull heavy cap of grey lead, crimped round the neck. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Dark slate-grey and charcoal storm clouds with paler grey cloud edges, a dull mid-grey lead cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.

what: a dish of foul grey ooze: a low, wide bowl of thick old glass standing on a short thick round foot, like a squat goblet with no stem, twice as wide as it is tall, with a thick rolled rim and no lid. It is brim-full of thick, smooth, heavy grey ooze exactly the colour of wet cement, a plain colourless mid-grey with paler grey highlights and charcoal folds, which heaps up above the rim in one sagging rounded mound, as tall again as the bowl, and slumps over the rim on the left side in one fat sluggish tongue that hangs half way down the outside. The glass is thick and the vessel is full nearly to the top, so the whole of it shows the strong colour of what is inside; nothing can be seen through it and the backdrop does not show through it.
colours: Plain colourless mid-grey ooze like wet cement, paler grey highlights, charcoal-grey folds, thick pale grey glass with white glints on the rim and foot.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: low wide glass bowl on a short thick foot
mound of grey ooze heaped above the rim
one fat tongue of ooze slumping over the rim

what: a smoky black vial: a small, narrow vial like a thick test tube, a straight tube with a rounded bottom, three times as tall as it is wide, of glossy black glass. Inside the black glass coils thick smoke: two bold curling ribbons of pale grey smoke wind up through the blackness from bottom to top, plain to see. A sharp pale grey line of light runs down the vial's whole left edge. It is closed with a bright cap of polished pewter, pale silver-grey, with a domed top.
colours: Glossy black glass, two bold pale grey ribbons of smoke inside, a pale grey lit edge, a bright pale pewter cap.
pose: Standing upright, seen from the front and a little from above.
must_show: narrow straight tube vial with a rounded bottom
black with pale grey smoke coiling inside
